meta.title: 面试感觉很好却被拒？四个原因解读
meta.title_en: Rejected Despite a Great Interview? Four Reasons

scenes.context: 讲者提出问题：面试感觉很好、反馈正面，最后却收到拒信。
sentences: 面试的时候自己感觉非常好。
You feel the interview went really well.
感觉非常好：feel it went really well
面试官反馈也非常正面。
And the interviewer's feedback is very positive.
反馈正面：positive feedback
最后却收到拒信。
But in the end, you get a rejection.
拒信：a rejection
paraphrase: 感觉好 → 不等于被录用
Feeling good isn't the same as getting hired.
A rejection deserves a look at the reasons.
scenes.speak: You feel the interview went really well. And the interviewer's feedback is very positive. But in the end, you get a rejection.

scenes.context: 讲者说明能力未验证与竞争激烈两个原因。
sentences: 面试是想象，你的能力没有被真正验证。
An interview is imagination—your ability isn't truly tested yet.
能力验证：ability isn't truly tested
到实际工作中，未必能用到这些能力。
In real work, those abilities may not even apply.
未必能用到：may not apply
竞争激烈，可能有比你更优秀的候选人。
It's competitive—there may be stronger candidates.
更优秀的候选人：stronger candidates
paraphrase: 面试表现 → 只是预测
Interview performance is only a prediction.
Choosing the best isn't the same as rejecting you.
scenes.speak: An interview is imagination—your ability isn't truly tested yet. In real work, those abilities may not even apply. It's competitive—there may be stronger candidates.

scenes.context: 讲者说明薪资超预算与岗位需求变化两个原因。
sentences: 你的期望薪资超出了对方的预算。
Your salary expectation exceeds their budget.
期望薪资：salary expectation
HR 谈薪谈不拢，最终只能拒绝。
If HR can't close the gap, they have to say no.
谈不拢：can't close the gap
岗位被取消，或被内部转岗消化掉了。
The role was cut, or filled internally through a transfer.
内部转岗：internal transfer
paraphrase: 薪资谈不拢 → 与能力无关
A salary gap isn't about your ability.
岗位变化 → 与你无关
Role changes are out of your control.
scenes.speak: Your salary expectation exceeds their budget. If HR can't close the gap, they have to say no. The role was cut, or filled internally through a transfer.

practice: I got a rejection even though the interview went well.
An interview only predicts, it doesn't prove ability.
My expectation was above their budget, so it fell through.
The role was filled internally, so they stopped hiring.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：The interviewer's feedback is very positive.
✓ 地道说法：The interviewer seemed genuinely impressed.
正面反馈用 impressed，比 positive feedback 自然。
✕ 直译腔：There are better candidates than me.
✓ 地道说法：There were stronger candidates this round.
✕ 直译腔：My salary hope exceeds the budget.
✓ 地道说法：My expectation was above their budget.
✕ 直译腔：The position was eaten by internal transfer.
✓ 地道说法：The role was filled internally.
shifts: 把面试顺利当能力证明
用实际工作成果持续证明
footer_notes: ASR 校正：原文口语（如「谈不拢」「感觉非常好」）按口播习惯保留，无专有名词口误需校正。场景/句子朗读使用 edge-tts，单词发音使用浏览器 Web Speech API。
